raw_text: A manipulated drone video purporting to show Indian Army soldiers crossing the Line of Control has been debunked by Indian defence officials and independent forensic analysts. The footage, which went viral on Pakistani social media channels, was found to splice authentic terrain imagery with digitally inserted military figures. The Indian Army termed the video 'a blatant fabrication designed to escalate tensions.'
clean_text: Manipulated drone video showing Indian soldiers crossing LoC debunked by defence officials. Forensic analysis confirms footage spliced authentic terrain with digitally inserted military figures.
